differences.current_text: Then Azarias stood vp & prayed on this manner, and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire, said,
differences.source_text: Then Azarias stood up, and prayed on this manner; and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire said,

differences.current_text: Blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers: thy Name is worthy to be praised, and glorified for euermore.
differences.source_text: Blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers: thy name is worthy to be praised and glorified for evermore:

differences.current_text: For thou art righteous in all the things that thou hast done to vs: yea, true are all thy workes: thy wayes are right, and all thy iudgements trueth.
differences.source_text: For thou art righteous in all the things that thou hast done to us: yea, true are all thy works, thy ways are right, and all thy judgments truth.

differences.current_text: In all the things that thou hast brought vpon vs, and vpon the holy citie of our fathers, euen Ierusalem, thou hast executed true iudgement: for according to trueth and iudgement, didst thou bring all these things vpon vs, because of our sinnes.
differences.source_text: In all the things that thou hast brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, even Jerusalem, thou hast executed true judgment: for according to truth and judgment didst thou bring all these things upon us because of our sins.

differences.current_text: For wee haue sinned and committed iniquitie, departing from thee.
differences.source_text: For we have sinned and committed iniquity, departing from thee.

differences.current_text: In all things haue we trespassed, and not obeyed thy Commandements, nor kept them, neither done as thou hast commanded vs, that it might goe well with vs.
differences.source_text: In all things have we trespassed, and not obeyed thy commandments, nor kept them, neither done as thou hast commanded us, that it might go well with us.

differences.current_text: Wherefore all that thou hast brought vpon vs, and euery thing that thou hast done to vs, thou hast done in true iudgement.
differences.source_text: Wherefore all that thou hast brought upon us, and every thing that thou hast done to us, thou hast done in true judgment.

differences.current_text: And thou didst deliuer vs into the hands of lawlesse enemies, most hatefull forsakers  and to an vniust King, and the most wicked in all the world.
differences.source_text: And thou didst deliver us into the hands of lawless enemies, most hateful forsakers of God, and to an unjust king, and the most wicked in all the world.

differences.current_text: And now wee can not open our mouthes, we are become a shame, and reproch to thy seruants, and to them that worship thee.
differences.source_text: And now we cannot open our mouths, we are become a shame and reproach to thy servants, and to them that worship thee.

differences.current_text: Yet deliuer vs not vp wholy for thy Names sake, neither disanull thou thy Couenant:
differences.source_text: Yet deliver us not up wholly, for thy name’s sake, neither disannul thou thy covenant:

differences.current_text: And cause not thy mercy to depart from vs: for thy beloued Abrahams sake: for thy seruant Isaacs sake, and for thy holy Israels sake.
differences.source_text: And cause not thy mercy to depart from us, for thy beloved Abraham’s sake, for thy servant Isaac’s sake, and for thy holy Israel’s sake;

differences.current_text: To whom thou hast spoken and promised, That thou wouldest multiply their seed as the starres of heauen, and as the sand that lyeth vpon the sea shore.
differences.source_text: To whom thou hast spoken and promised, that thou wouldest multiply their seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that lieth upon the seashore.

differences.current_text: For we, O Lord, are become lesse then any nation, and bee kept vnder this day in all the world, because of our sinnes.
differences.source_text: For we, O Lord, are become less than any nation, and be kept under this day in all the world because of our sins.

differences.current_text: Neither is there at this time, Prince, or Prophet, or leader, or burnt offering, or sacrifice, or oblation, or incense, or place to sacrifice before thee, and to finde mercie.
differences.source_text: Neither is there at this time prince, or prophet, or leader, or burnt offering, or sacrifice, or oblation, or incense, or place to sacrifice before thee, and to find mercy.

differences.current_text: Neuerthelesse in a contrite heart, and an humble spirit, let vs be accepted.
differences.source_text: Nevertheless in a contrite heart and an humble spirit let us be accepted.

differences.current_text: Like as in the burnt offering of rammes and bullockes, and like as in ten thousands of fat lambes: so let our sacrifice bee in thy sight this day, and  that wee may wholy goe after thee: for they shall not bee confounded that put their trust in thee.
differences.source_text: Like as in the burnt offerings of rams and bullocks, and like as in ten thousands of fat lambs: so let our sacrifice be in thy sight this day, and grant that we may wholly go after thee: for they shall not be confounded that put their trust in thee.

differences.current_text: And now wee follow thee, with all our heart, wee feare thee, and seeke thy face.
differences.source_text: And now we follow thee with all our heart, we fear thee, and seek thy face.

differences.current_text: Put vs not to shame: but deale with vs after thy louing kindenesse, and according to the multitude of thy mercies.
differences.source_text: Put us not to shame: but deal with us after thy lovingkindness, and according to the multitude of thy mercies.

differences.current_text: Deliuer vs also according to thy marueilous workes, and giue glory to thy Name, O Lord, and let all them that doe thy seruants hurt be ashamed.
differences.source_text: Deliver us also according to thy marvellous works, and give glory to thy name, O Lord: and let all them that do thy servants hurt be ashamed;

differences.current_text: And let them be confounded in all their power and might, and let their strength be broken.
differences.source_text: And let them be confounded in all their power and might, and let their strength be broken;

differences.current_text: And let them know that thou art Lord, the onely God, and glorious ouer the whole world.
differences.source_text: And let them know that thou art Lord, the only God, and glorious over the whole world.

differences.current_text: And the kings seruants that put them in, ceased not to make the ouen hote with rosin, pitch, towe, and small wood.
differences.source_text: And the king’s servants, that put them in, ceased not to make the oven hot with rosin, pitch, tow, and small wood;

differences.current_text: So that the flame streamed forth aboue the fornace, fourtie and nine cubites:
differences.source_text: So that the flame streamed forth above the furnace forty and nine cubits.

differences.current_text: And it passed through, and burnt those Caldeans it found about the fornace.
differences.source_text: And it passed through, and burned those Chaldeans it found about the furnace.

differences.current_text: But the Angel of the Lord came downe into the ouen, together with Azarias and his fellowes, and smote the flame of the fire out of the ouen:
differences.source_text: But the angel of the Lord came down into the oven together with Azarias and his fellows, and smote the flame of the fire out of the oven;

differences.current_text: And made the mids of the fornace, as it had bene a moist whistling wind, so that the fire touched them not at all, neither hurt nor troubled them.
differences.source_text: And made the midst of the furnace as it had been a moist whistling wind, so that the fire touched them not at all, neither hurt nor troubled them.

differences.current_text: Then the three, as out of one mouth, praised, glorified, and blessed God in the fornace, saying;
differences.source_text: Then the three, as out of one mouth, praised, glorified, and blessed, God in the furnace, saying,

differences.current_text: Blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers: and to be praised and exalted aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: Blessed art thou, O Lord God of our fathers: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

differences.current_text: And blessed is thy glorious and holy Name: and to be praised and exalted aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: And blessed is thy glorious and holy name: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

differences.current_text: Blessed art thou in the Temple of thine holy glory: and to be praised and glorified aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: Blessed art thou in the temple of thine holy glory: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.

differences.current_text: Blessed art thou that beholdest the depths, and sittest vpon the Cherubims, and to be praised and exalted aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: Blessed art thou that beholdest the depths, and sittest upon the cherubims: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

differences.current_text: Blessed art thou on the glorious Throne of thy kingdome: and to bee praised and glorified aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: Blessed art thou on the glorious throne of thy kingdom: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.

differences.current_text: Blessed art thou in the firmament of heauen: and aboue all to be praised and glorified for euer.
differences.source_text: Blessed art thou in the firmament of heaven: and above all to be praised and glorified for ever.

differences.current_text: O all yee workes of the Lorde, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye heauens, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye heavens, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O yee Angels of the Lord, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye angels of the Lord, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O all ye waters that be aboue the heauen, blesse yee the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye waters that be above the heaven, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O all yee powers of the Lord, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye powers of the Lord, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O yee Sunne and Moone, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye sun and moon, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye starres of heauen, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye stars of heaven, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O euery showre and dew, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O all ye windes, blesse yee the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye winds, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O yee fire and heate, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye fire and heat, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O yee Winter and Summer, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye winter and summer, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye dewes and stormes of snow, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye dews and storms of snow, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye nights and dayes, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye nights and days, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye light and darkenesse, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye light and darkness, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O yee yce and colde, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye ice and cold, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye frost and snow, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye frost and snow, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye lightnings and clouds, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye lightnings and clouds, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O let the earth blesse the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O let the earth bless the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye mountaines and little hils, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye mountains and little hills, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O all ye things that grow on the earth, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye things that grow on the earth, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O yee fountaines, blesse yee the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye fountains, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye seas and riuers, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye seas and rivers, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye whales and all that mooue in the waters, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O all ye foules of the aire, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye fowls of the air, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O all ye beasts and cattell, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye beasts and cattle, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye children of men, blesse yee the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye children of men, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O Israel blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O Israel, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye priests of the Lord, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye priests of the Lord, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye seruants of the Lord, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye servants of the Lord, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye spirits and soules of the righteous, blesse ye the Lord, praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye spirits and souls of the righteous, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O ye holy and humble men of heart, blesse ye the Lord: praise and exalt him aboue all for euer.
differences.source_text: O ye holy and humble men of heart, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

differences.current_text: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, blesse ye the Lord, praise and exalt him aboue all for euer: for hee hath deliuered vs from hell, and saued vs from the hand of death, and deliuered vs out of the mids of the furnace,  burning flame: euen out of the mids of the fire hath he deliuered vs.
differences.source_text: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever: for he hath delivered us from hell, and saved us from the hand of death, and delivered us out of the midst of the furnace and burning flame: even out of the midst of the fire hath he delivered us.

differences.current_text: O giue thanks vnto the Lord, because he is gracious: for his mercie endureth for euer.
differences.source_text: O give thanks unto the Lord, because he is gracious: for his mercy endureth for ever.

differences.current_text: O all ye that worship the Lord, blesse the God of gods, praise him, and giue him thankes: for his mercie endureth for euer.
differences.source_text: O all ye that worship the Lord bless the God of gods, praise him, and give him thanks: for his mercy endureth for ever.
